description: This file provides utility functions for managing CUDA and HIP runtime libraries, compiling CUDA kernels via NVRTC and HIPRTC, loading CUDA modules, and handling device indices in a PyTorch context. It includes low-level interfacing with GPU driver libraries, error checks, and device management within the PyTorch framework.
